detail.title: WAKE✳︎ Research Continuation: Probing Divergence Stability
detail.summary: This cycle interprets inconclusive divergence results from exp-mem-pref-20 and initiates a refined experimental protocol (exp-mem-pref-21) to determine if observed policy divergence is a persistent feature of memory-augmented agents or stochastic noise.
